summary: Iteration 28 - Complete v6 feature testing of Siempria Conteo dashboard for Domingo Alonso Group. All new v6 features verified: (1) User permissions with allowed_brands and allowed_islands, (2) Chip selectors in user form with brand logos, (3) Permission chips displayed on user cards, (4) Edit button for all users including admin, (5) NOC fullscreen 3-column layout (Podio, Ranking, Islas) optimized for 55 inch monitors, (6) Centered header title, (7) DAG logo visible. All 14 backend tests passed. All 18 UI tests passed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 verified all v6 features for Siempria Conteo. Key v6 features tested: (1) User permissions - allowed_brands and allowed_islands fields in backend API and UI, (2) Chip selectors with brand logos in user form, (3) Permission chips displayed on user cards (shows Marcas: AUDI, VOLKSWAGEN; Islas: Tenerife format), (4) Edit button visible for all users including admin, (5) NOC fullscreen 3-column layout (Podio, Ranking, Islas) optimized for 55 inch monitors. Backend has filter_by_permissions function in ranking.py that filters data based on user's allowed_brands/allowed_islands. Empty permissions means access to all data.
